mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, title, template, style, content, deleted, created_at, updated_at FROM resume WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = false
SELECT id, user_id, title, template, style, content, deleted, created_at, updated_at FROM resume WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = false ORDER BY updated_at DESC, id ASC
SELECT id, user_id, title, template, style, content, deleted, created_at, updated_at FROM resume WHERE ORDER BY updated_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{pageLimit} OFFSET #{pageOffset}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO resume ( id, user_id, title, template, style, content, deleted, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{userId}, #{title}, #{template}, #{style,typeHandler=com.resumecraft.common.persistence.JsonbTypeHandler}, #{content,typeHandler=com.resumecraft.common.persistence.JsonbTypeHandler}, #{deleted}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
